cover_letter: You need a reproducible forecasting model with a clear evaluation report for your manufacturing data. I built a demand‑casting pipeline that imports statsforecast and uses Optuna to tune models, returning processed batch predictions in Python. I also standardized model packaging, added canary releases and drift alerts, cutting time to production from six weeks to four days, which demonstrates my ability to deliver reproducible, monitored solutions. These experiences equip me to create a robust, reproducible model and a thorough evaluation report for your project.

You need an interactive leadership report built on a reliable data pipeline that can orchestrate workflows, validate incoming data, and generate forecasts for education stakeholders. I built a data pipeline that orchestrated tasks with Prefect and stored intermediate results in DuckDB, pulling source data from PostgreSQL tables. I wrote comprehensive validation checks for nulls, ranges and volumes on each load, rejecting rows that failed basic quality rules before they entered the warehouse. I have used pmdarima within a forecasting model that combined Excel data sources to produce time‑series predictions. I automated monthly close reporting with Excel, Power Query and SQL, delivering a workbook that reduced close time by three days. My work for a university involved creating dashboards that guided funding decisions and improved satisfaction metrics, showing experience with education‑focused leadership reporting.
